Name: Asters Bathrooms - Lnh's First FarmHouse compatible
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description[/u]
[list]
[*]LiuNianHui was kind enough to create a compatibility patch so my bathroom mod works with he farmhouse mod which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17526]here[/url].﻿
[*]My original mods which are compatible with the unmodded farmhouse can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404]here (bathroom extension﻿)[/url]  and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12150]here (bathroom replaces spouseroom)[/url]. The original mod is also compatible with a few other modded farmhouses. like the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11762]bigger farmhouse map[/url].
[*]These are just the content.json replacements for the original mod. So essentially you download the original mod and replace the content.json with the one in this mod.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Lnh很好心地创建了一个兼容性补丁，所以我的浴室模组与他的农舍模组一起工作，Lnh的第一个农舍的链接[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17526]在这里[/url]。
[*]我的原始模组与未改装的农舍兼容，可以[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404]在这里（浴室扩展[/url]）和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12150]这里（浴室取代配偶房间）[/url]找到。原始模组还与其他一些改装的农舍兼容。比如[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11762]更大的农舍地图[/url]。
[*]下载和使用此模组的说明与原始模组相似，因此如果您在使用它时遇到问题，请尝试阅读Lnh的第一个农舍的说明。但是，如果您在使用此模组时遇到任何困难，请随时发表评论，我将尽最大努力提供帮助，并根据需要在此页面上添加更多说明。
[/list]
[u]Future updates to do:[/u]
(note to self (me, Asterisk that is): Pack the content.json in with the rest of the files so it's a bit more user friendly and people don't have to do the file replacement method)
